## Description

A colonial peritrich with ~50 µm zooids at the tips of a branched stalk (mm colonies). The spasmoneme
is continuous through all the branches: on a stimulus the whole colony contracts at once.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 1 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [branched colony](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#branched-colonies) with `shared_spasmoneme`; up to 12
zooids per colony (then daughters leave as telotrochs). Stalk width, bending and branch angle
estimated.

## Not implemented yet

- Colonies are limited to 12 zooids.
- Macrozooids (dispersal) are not modelled.

## Unique and shared mechanics

The shared spasmoneme distinguishes it from *Carchesium*.
